findings.title: Recheck the cache after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: Concurrent production requests can all observe a nil cache under the read lock before any request finishes loading it. Each then acquires the write lock in turn and rereads and reparses the manifest, even though the first request has already populated the cache. This serializes redundant disk I/O and parsing across the initial request burst and blocks cache readers while those loads run. After acquiring the write lock, check the cache again and return it if non-nil in non-development mode.
